apiContracts: No API changes. This is a production deployment safety gate.
dataEntities: No D1 schema mutation. The gate only inventories repository migration filenames.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: No database change. The workflow checks the repository migration directory and refuses deployment when it contains migrations beyond the currently reviewed 0009-0011 release set.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: Existing production data and schema are untouched.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Remove the gate only after a reviewed deterministic rollout plan for the complete canonical migration chain is implemented and tested.

privacySecurity.ownerScoping: No user data is read or changed.
privacySecurity.productionSafety: Manual deployment remains explicit; unsupported migration sets are blocked before Cloudflare credentials or any remote D1 mutation.

integration: Exact gate assertion against migration numbers greater than 0011
isolation: Gate reads repository files only; it does not connect to production D1.

flags: No runtime flag. The manual production deploy workflow remains disabled unless the user explicitly confirms.
stagingSteps: Verify workflow blocks this canonical migration set before any Cloudflare credential check.
Do not run remote D1 or Worker deployment until migration rollout plan is reviewed.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert the gate only after replacement release controls are in place.
monitoringSignals: Deployment blocked due to unsupported migration sequence
Migration inventory and approved rollout manifest

collisionReview.migrationAllocation: No migration is added or applied.
collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: Deployment workflow owned by delivery-platform; regression test by platform-quality; architecture docs by platform-architecture.

changeSummary: Prevents the current manual production deploy workflow from publishing code while numbered migrations after 0011 remain unsupported by its migration application and verification steps.
acceptanceCriteria: Any numbered migration above 0011 causes the deploy job to fail before credentials or remote D1 actions.
The build includes a regression assertion for the gate.
No production D1 or Worker mutation is performed.
